stories.title: Define clinical trial phase score schema
stories.description: Create data contract for representing clinical trial phase and its derived numeric score, including allowed phase values (I, II, III, IV, N/A) and normalized score field.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models/clinical_trials_models.py (existing Pydantic models for trials; extend to include phase score field)

stories.title: Implement phase-to-score mapping logic
stories.description: Add deterministic function in clinical_trials_service to map ClinicalTrials.gov phase values to normalized numeric scores reflecting evidence maturity (e.g., Phase I lowest, Phase IV highest).

stories.title: Integrate phase score into clinical trial response
stories.description: Augment clinical trials service response to include computed phase score alongside raw phase, ensuring compatibility with evaluate_care_facade output.

stories.title: Unit tests for phase scoring logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating correct score assignment for each phase value and handling of missing or unexpected phase inputs.

stories.title: Integration test for phase score in API response
stories.description: Validate that clinical trial search responses include phase and computed score fields end-to-end through the facade layer.
